title: Review Packet v1
description: Local handoff artifact for human/model review of a completed agent mission. Does not depend on ChatGPT Mac app automation. Reviewer responses are not executed directly — they inform the next mission prompt.

session_id.description: Session that completed the mission and requests review.

parent_session_id.description: Parent session if this was a delegated task.

head.description: Git HEAD SHA at mission end.

final_report_path.description: Relative or absolute path to the final mission report Markdown file.

artifact_manifest_path.description: Path to artifact manifest JSON if available.

coordination_summary_path.description: Path to coordination event summary if available.

dataset_report_path.description: Path to dataset export report or manifest if available.

checkpoint_summary_path.description: Path to checkpoint summary if available.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of packet creation.

content_policy.description: Privacy policy for the packet contents.

forbidden_fields.description: Field names that MUST NOT appear in the packet.
